channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput.
item.description: Texas is the fastest-growing data center market in the US and ground zero for Big Tech’s largest AI buildouts. But the blue wave that swept the Lone Star State may jeopardize that position. Democrat James Talarico won the US Senate seat against Ken Paxton.

item.title: [news] Use decision models with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations
item.description: Some agent-evaluation questions are narrow and repeatable, and decision models answer exactly that kind of question.

item.title: [news] Agile Deliberation: How AI helps humans define the gray areas
item.description: Data Mining & Modeling

item.title: [news] Dharma Field Extractor: Any Document In, Structured Fields in JSON Out
[news] Progress on provable inference for large language models
item.description: Anthropic researchers have made progress on using zkSNARK cryptographic proofs to verify that a specific large language model generated a given response.

item.title: [news] Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick: Human oversight where it matters
item.description: Smart Approvals in Amazon Quick reviews eligible agent actions within existing controls to reduce unnecessary approval prompts while keeping consequential decisions human-led.

item.title: [news] Four layers of context engineering for production AI agents: How Deep Insight applies them in working code
item.description: In production AI agents, context management is the real bottleneck.

item.title: [news] How Indegene is modernizing and scaling enterprise data quality in life sciences
item.description: This post explores how Indegene built a production-grade, LLM-powered Data Quality Agent in its NEXT Unified Data Platform on AWS.

item.title: [news] How U Mobile built agentic telco operations with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: U Mobile built an agentic AI operations platform called AiDaH using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to enable autonomous action across telco operations.

item.title: [repo] silverdugongenhance/PromptReel
item.description: PromptReel is a free Windows desktop application that uses local AI to generate short video clips directly from text prompts.

item.title: [news] datasette-llm 0.1a10
item.description: Datasette-llm 0.1a10 fixes a bug that incorrectly restricted available LLM models on the agent.datasette.io demo site.

item.title: [tool] I built a tool that prices a prebuilt PC part by part
item.description: PC Deal Check is an AI-powered tool that reads computer product listings to evaluate pricing against market-based component estimates and provide a shareable report.

item.title: [news] The Data Science Interview in 2026: What’s Changed and How to Prepare
item.description: A round-by-round breakdown of how the hiring process has shifted, from AI-assisted coding rounds to GenAI evaluation questions, and what you need to do differently to be ready.

item.title: [news] OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
item.description: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company to expand Codex tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

item.title: [news] Securing the agentic enterprise with data lineage
item.description: A sales representative asks an AI agent for customer pricing, and the agent pulls data from multiple sources: restricted pricing systems, internal communications, and archived quotes.

item.title: [news] 7 Small Specialist Models That Beat Giant LLMs at One Job
item.description: Seven open specialist models under ten billion parameters rival much larger systems at specific tasks like transcription, OCR, routing, and speech.

item.title: [news] AI is forcing us to pay off 40 years of technical debt
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from spectrum.ieee.org. 844 points and 505 comments.

item.title: [news] Geoffrey Hinton: it might turn out we were better off without AI
item.description: Geoffrey Hinton warns that artificial intelligence could potentially trigger a major infrastructure incident such as a financial or power system blackout within the next few years.

item.title: [news] Tell HN: Gemini trains on chat history, even for subscribers (personal accounts)
item.description: Google allows saved chat history from personal Gemini accounts to be used for model training unless users turn off history or use temporary sessions.

item.title: [news] Nvidia RTX Spark encrypted firmware slows inference speed to 35% on Linux
item.description: Nvidia RTX Spark laptops running Linux experience GPU clock speed throttling that significantly reduces AI inference performance due to unreadable power management firmware.

item.title: [news] Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
item.description: OpenAI makes Daybreak Red available to approved customers in AWS GovCloud through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

item.title: [news] datasette-apps 0.3a0
item.description: Datasette Apps 0.3a0 adds support for hosting and editing custom HTML applications inside Datasette, which can be created using LLMs.

item.title: [news] datasette-agent 0.5a0
item.description: Datasette Agent 0.5a0 introduces a panel feature that allows the chat agent to sit alongside pages from Datasette like tables or queries.

item.title: [news] llm 0.37.1
item.description: LLM 0.37.1 is a bugfix release for the LLM utility with contributions from multiple developers.

item.title: [tool] P-H3-Image
item.description: Text-to-image and image editing, based on MiniMax-H3

item.title: [repo] Burakkylmz/ml-labs
item.description: Docker-based Python laboratory environment that provides a reproducible JupyterLab workspace pre-configured with core data science libraries for hands-on machine learning training.

item.title: [repo] johnpsasser/lifeboat
item.description: Offline emergency assistant that runs a local language model and a searchable library of medical and survival manuals on a single Mac.

item.title: [paper] Kierston & KierstonBench: Simulation of Allentown, PA and Evaluation of Language Models in Crime Investigation and Surveillance Tasks
item.description: Kierston and KierstonBench provide a simulated city-scale environment to evaluate large language models on criminal investigation tasks using linked surveillance records, revealing that only frontier models perform reliably while remaining vulnerable to deception.

item.title: [paper] Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
item.description: LoCo uses local preference learning to teach reasoning models when to stop deliberating, reducing output length substantially while preserving or improving accuracy across math and code tasks.

item.title: [paper] GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
item.description: GigaSpeech 3 provides 39,000 hours of weakly transcribed dialectal Arabic speech, enabling improved recognition across five dialects via self-supervised labeling and noisy-student refinement.

item.title: [paper] VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
item.description: VidUEU-Agent automates instruction data synthesis from raw videos via a multi-stage pipeline with autonomous iteration, yielding a 100K-sample dataset that improves multimodal model performance.

item.title: [repo] gmpetrov/agent-screenplay
item.description: Screenplay is a command-line tool that lets AI agents automatically record, edit, and produce polished videos of websites and desktop applications.

item.title: [paper] BEND 2.0: Benchmarking the Capabilities Needed to Design DNA
item.description: BEND 2.0 evaluates DNA language models on predicting mutation effects and guiding sequence design, revealing that linear readouts and post-training improve performance but context-specific and multi-objective design remain challenging.

item.title: [repo] crimeacs/OpenPetCam
item.description: Open-source, self-hosted pet camera system that provides live video, motion tracking, and alerts using an affordable user-owned server.

item.title: [repo] bytedance/axion1_0
item.description: Open-source agent models and training code that achieve frontier-level scientific reasoning and tool use through a simplified three-stage training recipe.

item.title: [model] moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro
item.description: Vision-language model from moonshotai. 797 downloads and 381 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
item.description: Dory1.0-4B is a 4-billion-parameter recurrent language model with elastic depth that improves accuracy and token efficiency by looping a shared block, outperforming larger models on multiple benchmarks.

item.title: [model] ccore/Qwen3.5-4B-GLB-3D-Coder
item.description: Text generation model from ccore. 8.7k downloads and 143 likes so far.

item.title: [repo] MarkIvor/predictorlab
item.description: PredictorLab is a self-hosted tabular machine learning tool for analysts that automatically prevents data leakage, calibrates probabilities, and generates a REST API.

item.title: [repo] StarTrail-org/DRPixel
item.description: Page-native deep research agent framework that renders scientific papers page by page to reason over text and visual content together.

item.title: [repo] ianTPE/tetra-unfold
item.description: Tetra-unfold is an interactive map tool that flattens a spherical world map or 360-degree photo onto a seamless rectangular tile for AI vision and trip planning.

item.title: [repo] NJohansen/handle-mcp
item.description: Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to plan weekly grocery budgets and fill the cheapest shopping carts on Danish delivery stores.

item.title: [paper] QFabric: Guarded Cross-Domain Task Recovery and Its Limits on a Linux-RTOS Board
item.description: QFabric demonstrates that migrating tasks to a microcontroller on heterogeneous boards fails to isolate them from Linux interference, emphasizing that guarded recovery mechanisms are essential to prevent harmful migrations.

item.title: [repo] Burakkylmz/llm-routing-evaluation-platform
item.description: Open-source LLM routing evaluation platform that benchmarks cost, latency, quality, and safety across different routing strategies with a Turkish banking domain pack.

item.title: [tool] MiniMax H3 Turbo Lora UNCENSORED Workflow
item.description: Video generation with a synchronized soundtrack

item.title: [model] Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex-Turbo-LoRA
item.description: Image-to-video model from Pika-Labs. 43.1k downloads and 142 likes so far.

item.title: [paper] Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
item.description: Using Muon to train mixture-of-experts language models increases routing imbalance in early layers, which can be mitigated by centering router inputs or reducing the optimizer learning rate.

item.title: [model] nvidia/NVIDIA-NemotronLabs-RE-USE
item.description: Audio to audio model from nvidia. 32.3k downloads and 178 likes so far.

item.title: [tool] Uncracked City, detective game where you question LLM suspects that lie
item.description: Detective game where players interrogate AI suspects across real cities and catch them in lies.

item.title: [paper] DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
item.description: Video diffusion model that extracts compact latent actions from visual transitions to serve as a universal cross-embodiment action learner.

item.title: [paper] From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
item.description: Conceptual framework proposing cognitive symbionts as lifelong personal AI companions designed to augment human intelligence.

item.title: [paper] Aligning Language Models with General Preferences: An Empirical Study of Direct Nash Optimization
item.description: Direct Nash Optimization aligns language models with general preferences by approximating a Nash equilibrium through iterative on-chain sampling and contrastive updates.

item.title: [paper] PolicyIK: High-Precision Inverse Kinematics for Robot Arms with Reinforcement Learning
item.description: PolicyIK is a goal-conditioned reinforcement learning policy that provides high-precision inverse kinematics for robot arms to execute end-effector commands.

item.title: [paper] GUILD: Guided Iterative Data Collection for Imitation Learning
item.description: GUILD is a guided data collection method that uses vision-language models and predictive data attribution to iteratively curate high-quality datasets for imitation learning.

item.title: [paper] Visibility-Aware Reference Generation for Benchmarking Visual 3D Reconstruction in Vegetation-Rich Environments
item.description: Visibility-Aware Reference Generation is a LiDAR-based pipeline that generates depth maps and visible reference point clouds to benchmark 3D reconstruction in vegetation-rich environments.

item.title: [paper] GSCV++: Lightweight 3D Gaussian Splatting Sequence Compression via Standard Video Codecs
item.description: GSCV++ is a lightweight pipeline for compressing 3D Gaussian Splatting sequences using standard video codecs by improving preprocessing, mapping, and compression configurations.

item.title: [paper] Suppressing Misaligned Behaviors in Language Models, Durably
item.description: Prefix-Expanded Adversarial Reinforcement Learning is a reinforcement learning variant that suppresses misaligned language model behaviors by augmenting rollouts with intermediate states.

item.title: [paper] Reading Why: Born-Measured Attention with Exact Word Evidence on Light and Qubits
item.description: Born-Measured Attention is a transformer architecture that replaces standard attention and nonlinearities with Born measurements to compute exact word evidence and class probabilities.

item.title: [paper] OpenBrain: An Auditable Generated-Label Release for Whole-Brain MRI Parcellation
item.description: OpenBrain is a confidence-aware release of whole-brain MRI parcellations that provides auditable case records and a reference-free reliability panel for quality filtering.

item.title: [paper] Agnostic Learning by Imitating
item.description: Researchers prove that training a discriminative classification model and training an indistinguishable generative model are computationally equivalent tasks in learning theory.

item.title: [paper] Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
item.description: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning trains draft models to be rejected at critical decision points to improve the long-horizon reasoning and coding accuracy of large language model agents.

item.title: [paper] A Circuit for In-Context Learning
item.description: Researchers map the internal computational circuit that enables transformers to perform few-shot in-context learning with arbitrary labels in a single forward pass.

item.title: [paper] Weight-space programming for auditing clinical decision networks
item.description: Study demonstrates that a frontier language model can successfully audit and repair clinical neural networks by directly analyzing and modifying their raw weights.

item.title: [paper] MedPhysBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Medical Physics Calculations and Error Detection
item.description: MedPhysBench is a new benchmark featuring calculation generators and error detection tasks to evaluate language models on medical physics workflows.

item.title: [paper] A simple adaptive accelerated optimistic dual averaging method for unconstrained convex optimization in $p$-norm geometry
item.description: Researchers propose an adaptive accelerated optimistic dual averaging method for unconstrained convex optimization that uses low-cost p-norm geometry preconditioning.

item.title: [paper] CATF: A Manager-Worker Framework for Context-Aware Time-Series Forecasting
item.description: CATF is a manager-worker framework for context-aware time-series forecasting that uses a Transformer manager to hard-route inputs to specialized worker models.

item.title: [paper] PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
item.description: PyRUA-DataFarm uses a coding agent and simulation to generate synchronized, real-ready robot demonstration data at a low cost without requiring physical teleoperation.

item.title: [paper] HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation
item.description: HARP is a training-free agentic communication framework for LLM-based recommenders that uses symmetric item profiles and retrieval-time homophily to improve recommendation performance.

item.title: [paper] MDSKILL: Learning to Internalize Skill Memory through Multi-View Distillation for Efficient Dynamic Agent Self-Evolution
item.description: MDSKILL is a multi-view distillation approach that organizes skill memories into functional views to improve agent self-evolution and reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] $Φ$asmaNet: A Staged Spectral Token-Refinement Architecture for Fast Gravitational-Wave Signal-to-Noise Ratio Prediction
item.description: PhiasmaNet is a compact neural architecture that uses staged spectral token refinement to predict gravitational-wave signal-to-noise ratios orders of magnitude faster than conventional methods.

item.title: [paper] You don't need long context
item.description: Study demonstrates that language models can maintain high task accuracy on long-horizon and long-input tasks by using frequent context compaction instead of relying on long-context windows.

item.title: [paper] LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
item.description: LoopVQ is a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that jointly codes channels of multiple loop steps to reduce decode latency and memory bottlenecks.

item.title: [news] How I use AI (Oct 2026)
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from ben.stolovitz.com. 131 points and 112 comments.

item.title: [paper] Universal Hardness From Masking Channels
item.description: Masking channels-based universal hardcore lemma framework certifies the hardness of learning non-Boolean functions by choosing the right fidelity via convex duality.

item.title: [paper] GSBR: Geometric Support Behavior Regularization for Online RL
item.description: Geometric Support Behavior Regularization penalizes actions by their distance from a base policy's support to improve online reinforcement learning success rates and throughput in robotics.

item.title: [paper] Wonder 4: A Mixture-of-Experts Recipe for Image Quality Enhancement
item.description: Wonder 4 is a mixture-of-experts image quality enhancement model that corrects multiple simultaneous photograph defects in specific regions without using degradation classifiers or extra modules.

item.title: [paper] Personas Are Not People: Identity as State, Not Attribute
item.description: Identity-as-state analysis proves that fixed-persona language model simulations cannot reproduce context-specific human behavior, and proposes a new evaluation criterion.

item.title: [paper] Low-Density 3D Point Cloud Classification
item.description: LD-PointNet++ is an optimized architecture for classifying low-density 3D point clouds, maintaining consistent high accuracy across varying density levels.

item.title: [paper] False Reassurance in LLM Severe-Weather Guidance: A Replayable Evaluation Against Real NWS Alerts
item.description: Replayable evaluation against real National Weather Service alerts measures false reassurance in LLM severe-weather guidance and demonstrates the effectiveness of real alert access.

item.title: [paper] Knowingly Wrong: Training LLMs Against Their Own Beliefs can Induce Misalignment
item.description: Fine-tuning language models on data they believe to be false can induce broad internal inconsistency and misalignment across tasks without significant loss of general capability.

item.title: [paper] Anchored Rank-Adversarial Fine-Tuning Pretrained Visual Place Recognition Models
item.description: Anchored rank-adversarial fine-tuning (ARAFT) improves the adversarial robustness of visual place recognition foundation models while preserving clean accuracy.

item.title: [paper] YANAMI: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Multiturn Stateful Interaction
item.description: YANAMI introduces a large-scale multimodal dialogue dataset and benchmark for stateful interaction, requiring models to track and realize evolving dialogue states across turns, and reveals that current unified multimodal models still struggle with this task.

item.title: [paper] Möbius: A Unified Motion-Language Model Bridging Understanding and Generation
item.description: Mobius is a unified motion-language model that operates directly on continuous frame-level raw motion to support motion understanding, generation, and editing within a single framework.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Accuracy: What Language-Subspace Interventions Capture, Remove, and Improve
item.description: Language-subspace interventions aim to improve multilingual reasoning by suppressing language-related components in mid-layer activations, but evaluation shows they rarely improve joint accuracy without damaging response-language fidelity.

item.title: [paper] Conformal Prediction at Performative Equilibrium: The Price of Performativity
item.description: Conformal prediction in performative settings establishes a phase transition at sensitivity L=1, proving that finite-sample procedures cannot guarantee equilibrium-valid coverage when L is greater than or equal to 1.

item.title: [paper] De Rham cohomological architectures for PINNs and PDEs with topological holes
item.description: Hodge-de Rham PINNs introduce de Rham cohomological augmentations using the Hodge-Morrey-Friedrichs decomposition to solve physics-informed neural network failures in scenarios with topological holes.

item.title: [paper] Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
item.description: Route Anything is a framework for dynamically selecting and coordinating specialized AI models and policies across diverse tasks to improve performance and efficiency.

item.title: [paper] The Geometry of Ignorance: Detecting Suppressed Knowledge in LLMs through Activation Fragmentation
item.description: Activation fragmentation measures the geometric coherence of hidden-state differences between concept queries and paraphrases to detect suppressed parametric knowledge in large language models without using attacks.

item.title: [paper] iGC: Antibody Optimization via Reinforcement Learning over a Learned Somatic Hypermutation Prior
item.description: iGC is a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that models somatic hypermutation priors and optimizes antigen binding to improve computational antibody affinity maturation.

item.title: [paper] Stabilizing On-Policy Targeted Guidance in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Targeted guidance combines on-policy self-distillation with per-criteria reinforcement learning to improve hard-to-optimize agentic behaviors using per-turn textual feedback.

item.title: [paper] Gaussian Partitioning for Reliable Learning of Multi-Index Models
item.description: Gaussian partitioning is an algorithmic primitive that divides space into polyhedral regions to efficiently agnostically learn complex Boolean multi-index models under smooth input marginals.

item.title: [paper] JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
item.description: JHiMA-WebRL is a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that couples a task decomposer and an actor to improve long-horizon web navigation tasks.

item.title: [paper] NovoCRF: Globally Normalized De Novo Peptide Sequencing on a Prefix-Mass Lattice
item.description: NovoCRF is a conditional random field model for de novo peptide sequencing that uses exact global normalization over mass-feasible peptides on a prefix-mass lattice.

item.title: [paper] Going Deeper With Memories
item.description: DeepMem is a causal multiscale byte-level language model architecture that separates semantic compression from exact byte preservation to reduce computational costs while maintaining strong performance.

item.title: [paper] Logarithmic Regret for Alternating Mirror Descent
item.description: Alternating online mirror descent achieves an O(log(T)) regret bound for two-player zero-sum bilinear games, resolving an open question in learning theory.

item.title: [paper] Shrinkage prior for implicit generative models
item.description: A sample-efficient training mechanism uses shrinkage priors and generalized Bayes inference to improve parameter estimation in implicit generative models.

item.title: [paper] Post-stratified importance sampling
item.description: Post-stratified importance sampling reformulates high-dimensional weighting into one-dimensional probabilistic models to improve estimation accuracy and uncertainty quantification.

item.title: [paper] ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals
item.description: ARLoop is a looped transformer architecture that uses attention residuals to improve performance and parameter efficiency in large language model pretraining.

item.title: [paper] Diagnosis by Composition: Detecting and Localizing Unseen Diseases by Composing Learned Radiological Findings
item.description: Diagnosis by composition is an interpretable radiological framework that detects and localizes unseen diseases by combining learned finding maps according to clinical guidelines.

item.title: [paper] Regret-based Characterization, Information Limits, and the Sample Complexity of Auditing Adaptive Policies
item.description: A new method characterizes the adaptivity gap and sample complexity of auditing Markov policies in finite-horizon MDPs using information-theoretic bounds.

item.title: [paper] Post-Inference Model Chaining: A Problem Statement and a Model-based Bootstrap for Training End-to-End Digital Twins
item.description: A model-based bootstrap technique reduces relative mean bias and improves coverage when training end-to-end digital twins through post-inference model chaining.

item.title: [paper] Learning curves in natural and artificial systems
item.description: A mathematical model of experience formation derives how situation occurrence distributions shape learning curves in both natural and artificial systems.

item.title: [paper] PLANTEUR: A Crop-Type Segmentation Benchmark for Tropical Regions
item.description: Planteur is an open-source crop-type segmentation benchmark featuring multi-sensor satellite image sequences across multiple tropical regions for cross-territory evaluation.

item.title: [paper] Fairness Metrics based on the AUC in Clinical Predictive AI
item.description: An evaluation of AUC-based fairness metrics in clinical prediction models highlights limitations from non-collapsibility and recommends reporting a comprehensive AUC matrix.

item.title: [paper] Fusing Earth observation embeddings and spaceborne terrain with meteorological forcing for flood peak depth prediction from high-water marks
item.description: A cross-modal fusion network uses spaceborne terrain, foundation model embeddings, and meteorological forcing to predict flood peak depths from field observations 6 hours ahead of the peak.

item.title: [paper] Physics-informed traditional and generative Mori-Zwanzig-reduced models for multiscale systems
item.description: A reduced-order modeling framework uses bases discovered by physics-informed machine learning and the Mori-Zwanzig formalism with fluctuation-dissipation and generative closures to improve predictions of multiscale systems.

item.title: [paper] Privacy for Free in Efficient Agnostic Halfspace Learning
item.description: Computationally efficient, differentially private algorithms for agnostically learning halfspaces match non-private sample complexity across three distinct learning settings.

item.title: [paper] Multi-Objective Generative Optimization via Expected Hypervolume Fine-Tuning
item.description: Hypervolume Fine-Tuning adapts a pretrained generative model to maximize the expected hypervolume of its samples, jointly improving candidate quality and trade-off coverage for scientific design tasks.

item.title: [paper] Diffusion Plug-in Priors for Self-Supervised Ultrasound Video Restoration
item.description: UltraDiff uses a frozen pretrained diffusion model as a plug-in prior alongside a speckle-aware data fidelity term to jointly super-resolve and despeckle ultrasound videos without paired training data.

item.title: [paper] TAQ-MOTR: Tracking-Aware Detection Query Formation for End-to-End Multiple Object Tracking
item.description: TAQ-MOTR uses a pre-decoder hybrid query generator that conditions detection queries on trajectory states to discover untracked objects and provide complementary evidence for occluded objects in multi-object tracking.

item.title: [paper] Empirical Bayes Flow Matching for Continuous Cryo-EM Heterogeneity
item.description: Empirical Bayes Flow Matching uses a Monte Carlo stochastic approximation Expectation-Maximization framework to learn generative priors directly from indirect observations, enabling continuous heterogeneity recovery in cryo-electron microscopy.

item.title: [paper] Robust Reconstruction of Power Lines from Incomplete Mobile and Aerial LiDAR Data
item.description: An automated reconstruction method combining scaled density-based clustering, robust polynomial fitting, and iterative fragment merging recovers individual power lines from incomplete mobile and aerial LiDAR data.

item.title: [paper] Ensembles of Random Partition-Based Models under Covariate Shift
item.description: New discrepancy measures of covariate shift severity extend the risk theory of partition-based kernel estimators to ensembles, showing that larger ensemble sizes achieve minimax-optimal risk convergence rates under severe covariate shifts.

item.title: [paper] Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
item.description: FactEmbed decouples compositional query comprehension in composed image retrieval by using factorized latents to simulate intended visual modifications through an intermediate target imagination objective.

item.title: [paper] From Natural Images to Medical Scans: Transferability of Diffusion Models for Medical Image Generation
item.description: Transfer learning from natural images using diffusion denoisers consistently improves medical image generation fidelity by leveraging shared spatial structures across domains.

item.title: [paper] Stepsize modulation for cross entropy from local quadratic optimization
item.description: Two stepsize modulation methods perturb stochastic gradient descent schedules using local quadratic optimization to reduce cross-entropy loss faster and increase training monotonicity.

item.title: [paper] Provably Learning Mixtures of Linear Experts
item.description: A novel global convergence guarantee for gradient EM training of mixture-of-expert models demonstrates that random initialization and polynomial iterations can successfully train these networks.

item.title: [paper] What Does the Model See? Representation Validity in Multimodal LLM-Based Video Analysis
item.description: Evaluating multimodal large language models on video analysis tasks reveals that input representation validity varies significantly by construct and requires empirical validation.

item.title: [paper] OperAItor: An Agentic Framework for Fault-Tolerant Operation of Chemical Processes
item.description: OperAItor is an open-source agentic framework that integrates process monitoring and safety checks to provide fault-tolerant supervisory control for chemical processes.

item.title: [paper] PadLoc: Training-Free Floor-Plan Localization by Sparse Geometric Matching
item.description: PadLoc is a training-free floor-plan localization back-end that uses sparse geometric matching and Bayes filtering to accurately place moving sensors within known maps.

item.title: [paper] AgentAM: An AI Agent for Spatter- and Defect-Aware Process Optimization in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
item.description: AgentAM is a large language model agent that provides natural-language access to predictive simulations for defect-aware process optimization in laser powder bed fusion.

item.title: [paper] Learning Behaviorally Relevant Dynamics in Multimodal Neural Recordings
item.description: BREM-NET is a nonlinear multimodal dynamical model that fuses disparate neural recordings with behavioral data to accurately separate behaviorally relevant brain dynamics.

item.title: [paper] When Self-Verification Hurts: Calibrated Answer Repair for Financial Question Answering
item.description: Calibrated Answer Repair is a targeted financial question-answering method that balances evidence verification and bounded editing to improve accuracy while lowering token costs.

item.title: [paper] Basin2Vec: Learning Basin-Centric Embeddings for Scalable Hydrological Modeling
item.description: Basin2Vec is a self-supervised framework that learns compact basin-centric embeddings from hydroclimatic data to improve streamflow prediction in ungauged regions.

item.title: [paper] RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
item.description: RoboTryOn converts human demonstration videos into target robot videos using virtual try-on techniques, improving policy learning success rates on novel manipulation tasks without real robot demonstrations.

item.title: [paper] Perturb, Repair, Verify: Self-Play Vision-Language Verifiers for Compositional Understanding
item.description: PROVE is a self-play framework that trains vision-language verifiers through a perturb-verify-repair loop using a shared multimodal backbone to improve compositional understanding and visual-detail robustness.

item.title: [paper] Macrocanonical Generator Networks: Data-Efficient Neural Surrogates for Amortized Physics Simulation
item.description: Macrocanonical generator networks use neural surrogates to match multiscale statistics of stationary physical processes, generating new realizations significantly faster than traditional simulations while preserving realistic fluctuations.

item.title: [paper] Asynchronous Robot Policies
item.description: Asynchronous Robot Policy decouples semantic reasoning from low-level action generation using asynchronous processes, enabling real-time robot reactivity and higher success rates in manipulation tasks.

item.title: [paper] Catalyzing Interactive HTML Generation Capabilities via High-Fidelity Reinforcement Learning
item.description: WebCatalyst is a browser-interaction reinforcement learning framework that uses a game-level GUI assessor, visual anchor, and action-trace credit to improve interactive HTML generation capabilities.

item.title: [paper] Creating Power Flexibility in Datacenters via Query Routing
item.description: Dynamic query routing across language model instances provides datacenter power demand flexibility up to 16% of total consumption while maintaining service for interactive workloads.

item.title: [paper] GM League Arena: An Interactive Long-Horizon Task Benchmark Based on Professional Sports League Management
item.description: GM Bench evaluates the long-horizon decision-making and management capabilities of large language models by tasking them with managing professional sports teams across multiple seasons under resource constraints.

item.title: [paper] When Cell Crops Share a Parent: Measuring and Isolating Acquisition Leakage in Cervical Cytology Benchmarks
item.description: Crop-level splitting in cervical cytology benchmarks artificially inflates accuracy due to shared acquisition parents, demonstrating that parent-disjoint splits are necessary for accurate evaluation.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Foundation Models: PFN Priors Improve Tabular Hyperparameter Optimization
item.description: PriorTune meta-tunes hyperparameter configurations on synthetic tasks derived from prior data, improving the performance of conventional tabular models without extra inference cost.

item.title: [paper] Meta$^2$: Precomputing Reusable Knowledge for Online Harness Evolution in Long-Horizon Agents
item.description: Meta2 learns reusable textual meta-skills offline to guide online harness evolution for long-horizon agents, enabling adaptive prompting and tool use during task execution.

item.title: [paper] A Random Matrix Analysis of Symmetric Tensor Unfolding
item.description: Random matrix theory analysis of symmetric tensor unfolding reveals a sharp phase transition for partial recovery and shows that unfolded symmetric tensors spectrally behave like standard Wigner matrices.

item.title: [paper] From Opinions to Commitments: Unstable Assignments and Silent Choices in AI-Mediated Proposals
item.description: An empirical evaluation of four large language models acting as mediators demonstrates that prompt variations and reordering frequently produce unstable collective proposals with hidden assignments and excluded views.

item.title: [paper] PAC Learning with Multiple Correct Answers
item.description: A theoretical study of PAC learning with multiple correct answers proves that demonstrations are significantly harder than full label sets or bandit feedback, establishing precise sample complexity bounds and learnability conditions.

item.title: [paper] High-fidelity training-free photovoltaic module mapping from multi-view UAV imagery
item.description: Multi-View PV Module Mapper is a training-free framework that couples vision foundation models with UAV photogrammetry to automatically generate high-fidelity, geometrically accurate maps of individual photovoltaic modules.

item.title: [paper] Solving the Nonlinear Westervelt Equation in Ultrasound Propagation Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
item.description: Physics-Informed Neural Networks utilizing a sinusoidal activation function successfully solve the nonlinear 1D Westervelt equation for ultrasound propagation across linear, shock-dominated, and dissipation-dominated scenarios.

item.title: [paper] Do Ray-Traced Cities Make a Better Channel Prior for an Unseen Site? A Pre-Registered Study in Simulation, and a Test on Measured Channels that Reverses It
item.description: A pre-registered study comparing ray-traced city channel priors with stochastic models finds that simulated channels overestimate performance, while measured environments show traditional 3GPP models often outperform ray-traced priors.

item.title: [paper] The Right Source Is Not Enough: Understanding History Interference in Speech-LLM Memory
item.description: Controlled experiments on speech large language models reveal that irrelevant historical audio causes errors by directing computations toward competing answers, demonstrating that source-role identification alone does not prevent history interference.

item.title: [paper] Towards an Optimal Control Foundation of Early Exits - Turnpikes and ResNets
item.description: An optimal control analysis of ResNets proves that jointly optimizing loss functions for output and intermediate layers induces the turnpike phenomenon, bounding the required layer depth independently of overall network depth.

item.title: [paper] Distributed Linear Bandits for Freshness-Aware Preprocessing in MEC-Enabled Digital Twin Networks
item.description: A freshness-aware framework for MEC-enabled digital twin networks uses a distributed linear bandit algorithm to optimize CPU allocation across task classes, reducing preprocessing delay while meeting age-of-information requirements.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Multi-Index Models: Learning Intersections of Degree-2 PTFs
item.description: A PAC learning algorithm for intersections of degree-2 polynomial threshold functions over a Gaussian distribution achieves classification error using time and samples with a dimension exponent independent of the accuracy parameter.

item.title: [paper] From AutoResearch to Continual AutoResearch: Do Agents Learn Across Tasks?
item.description: Continual AutoResearch is an open-ended framework that evaluates persistent and reset autonomous agents across multiple task families to measure research efficiency and performance.

item.title: [paper] Label-Preserving Fourier Domain Adaptation with Generative-AI and Real Style Donors for 3D Mitral Valve Segmentation
item.description: Fourier Domain Adaptation uses generative AI images as style donors to improve the boundary and surface segmentation of 3D mitral valve datasets.

item.title: [paper] Workload-Static Optical Circuit Switching For Scalable LLM Inference Decode
item.description: Workload-static optical circuit switching is a network design that configures circuits once per deployment to improve LLM inference decode interactivity and energy efficiency.

item.title: [paper] Molecular Prior Networks
item.description: Molecular Prior Networks is a transformer-based affinity modeling approach that predicts small molecule and protein target binding in a single forward pass without task-specific training.

item.title: [paper] Characterizing the vertical continuity of fuel strata based on TLS point clouds Gaussian decomposition and overlap metrics
item.description: Gaussian decomposition applied to terrestrial laser scanning point clouds characterizes the vertical continuity and fuel strata of forest structures for fire behavior analysis.

item.title: [paper] Dual-VaDE: Efficient and Robust Prototype Learning via Variational Dual-Domain Mixture Priors
item.description: Dual-VaDE is an unsupervised generative framework that uses a dual-domain Gaussian mixture prior to learn interpretable anatomical prototypes from unlabeled medical images.
